extracted.name: Steamed Broccoli
extracted.description: Steamed broccoli mixed with crispy cooked bacon and butter is a tasty side dish that is quick and easy to prepare any night of the week.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Place a steamer insert into a saucepan and fill with water to just below the bottom of the steamer. Bring water to a boil. Add broccoli, cover, and steam until tender, 3 to 5 minutes.
Mix steamed broccoli, bacon, butter, salt, and pepper together in a bowl.
